They are downloads, not site pages. ## Prompt research archive | | | | --- | --- | | Address | `https://cdn.shaughv.com/prompts` | | Redirect | HTTP 302 to the original S3 archive; its availability is separate from Vercel | | Behavior | Redirects to the large original research ZIP | ```html Download prompt research archive ``` ## Prompt skill bundle One HTTP response cannot reliably trigger two file downloads. `prompts-skill.zip` nests the two original skill archives so a single click stays intact. | | | | --- | --- | | Address | `https://cdn.shaughv.com/prompts-skill` | | Type | `application/zip` attachment | | Contains | `agentic-prompt-engineering.zip` and `loop-escape.zip` | ```html Download prompt skill packages ``` :::note The outer zip stores the inner archives without recompressing them. Replace a nested skill by rebuilding the outer archive and updating the expected hashes in the test suite. ::: ## Website entry The CDN overview lists both packages under **The packages.** with copy that matches these addresses. Open the Downloads section
